biggest_catch: $1,000 requires $10,000+ per month in qualifying direct deposits for TWO consecutive months by February 1, 2027 - a very high direct-deposit bar. Account must be opened August 28 - October 27, 2026 with promo code 1000DMD826. A lower $500 tier (code 500DMD826, $5,000/mo DD) also exists.
catches: Open new Commerce Free, Commerce Relationship, or Commerce Interest checking between August 28, 2026 and October 27, 2026 with promo code 1000DMD826.
$10,000+ per month in qualifying direct deposits for two consecutive months by February 1, 2027 (a $500 tier with $5,000/mo DD, code 500DMD826, also exists).
Qualifying DDs: recurring electronic paycheck, pension, or government benefits; Zelle/P2P not considered direct deposits.
No Commerce checking account owned and no previous checking bonus received in the 12 months before account opening.
Cannot combine with other checking offers; one offer per household.
Bonus paid on or before March 1, 2027, if account remains open; Commerce determines eligibility as of February 1, 2027.
Bonus reported as interest to IRS.
Offer may be revoked, restricted, or changed at any time.
Monthly service charge waived first 60 days for Interest/Relationship checking; thereafter avoid $12 fee with $500+ DD or $1,000 daily balance.
